'''Elsie''' is a maid that works for [[House Matherin]], in [[Andor]].

==Appearance==
Elsie is a tall woman with dark hair and dark eyes. She is in her twenties.

==Activities==
Elsie helped [[Elayne Trakand]] dress when the [[Daughter-Heir]] visited House Matherin. She screams when she sees the ghost of [[Nelein Matherin]].{{ref/book|10|10}}
